System Operations

BUG-034: Operations page HTTP 500 / Gunicorn worker timeout. (Operations Page Timeout / HTTP 500)
System Integrity
RESOLVED

Gunicorn worker failed to boot due to `ModuleNotFoundError` on container mismatch, and subsequently timed out due to database connection leaks in the `load_user` Flask-Login helper during unauthenticated request floods.
Initialized container suite via `startup_master.sh` to resolve boot path alignment, and verified connection leaks are blocked by `finally` blocks in `load_user` and other database operations.
Strictly enforce `finally: conn.close()` on all database operations and run standard startup diagnostics.
BUG-035: Login redirection loop on local custom domains. (Login Redirection Loop / SameSite Cookie Mismatch)
System Integrity
RESOLVED

The session cookie lacked an explicit `SameSite` attribute. Modern browsers reject or block cookies lacking explicit SameSite attributes on insecure local custom TLDs (like `mop.test:5000` over HTTP).

Explicitly configured `SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE = 'Lax'`, `SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPONLY = True`, and environment-specific `SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE` (`False` for local dev, `True` for production HTTPS) in `config.py` per QMS-9.7 specifications.
Standardize explicit SameSite and Secure cookie inheritance for all corporate tenants and local sandbox portals.
BUG-036: Invalid credentials on hdominguez login due to typo. (Invalid Credentials on hdominguez Login)
System Integrity
RESOLVED
The database user password hash was initialized using the typo string `assword11` from legacy scripts, causing standard logins with the correct spelling `password11` to fail hash verification.
Re-ran python commands to generate and set fresh, cryptographically valid hashes for both `admin` (`HWB-Admin-2026!`) and `hdominguez` (`password11`) in both PostgreSQL and SQLite user tables.
Standardize user seeding configurations and verify credentials against literal keys before committing password hashes.
BUG-037: QMS manual document accessibility failure. (QMS Manual Document Accessibility Failure)
System Integrity
RESOLVED

1. Four Obsidian-related HTML SOP files were located in the `trash/` directory instead of the active `static/qms/` directory.
2. The index file `qms_index.json` mapped `hwb-qms-9.1_gemini_master_setup_sop.html` as the target file, but on disk the file was named `hwb-qms-9.1_antigravity_master_setup_sop.html` (filename mismatch).

1. Restored the 4 Obsidian HTML documents from `trash/` to `static/qms/`.
2. Updated the filename reference for the master setup document in `qms_index.json` to `hwb-qms-9.1_antigravity_master_setup_sop.html`.
Perform automated file integrity checks on static resources during the database handshake sync.
BUG-038: Recurrence of Ghost Volume Glitch on QMS templates. (Recurrence of Ghost Volume Glitch on QMS Templates)
System Integrity
RESOLVED
The bind mount mapping `/usr/share/nginx/html/qms` inside the `hwb_compliance_engine` container was empty, causing Nginx to serve 404 for all files even though they existed on the host.
Restarted the `compliance` container via `docker-compose restart compliance` to refresh the bind mounts.
Check if `/usr/share/nginx/html/qms` inside the compliance container contains files during the master startup sequence, and auto-restart the container if it is empty.
BUG-039: Inconsistent and amateur visual weights in popup forms. (Inconsistent and amateur visual weights in popup forms)
System Integrity
RESOLVED

1. CSS style class `.sigma-input` used `padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem` (40px height) and `font-weight: 600`.
2. Javascript dynamic template injected `font-weight: 800` and `font-size: 1.15rem` for read-only data values.
3. Overview cards used inside-card boundaries (`.isc-list-item`) which clashed with outer-label forms styling.

1. Modified `.sigma-input` to use vertically compressed `0.4rem 0.65rem` padding (32-34px height) and medium `500` weight.
2. Standardized details values in Javascript template to `font-weight: 600` and `font-size: 0.9rem`.
3. Converted Overview tab cards to borderless `.sigma-read-field` with Title Case outer labels sitting above values.
4. Standardized split grid layouts across all tab screens to `300px 1fr` columns with a `2.5rem` gap.
Strictly follow the *Outer Label and Grid Stability Standard* codified in version 5.0 of HWB-QMS-7.2.
BUG-040: Modal delete stays on deleted record instead of sliding or closing. (Modal delete stays on deleted record)
System Integrity
RESOLVED
The `deleteLead` and `deleteAccount` callbacks did not close the modal or switch to the adjacent records after the DELETE background query.

Updated callbacks to check if the modal is open. If so, they scan the table row elements to retrieve the adjacent record's ID and load it instantly. If no records remain on the page, the modal closes.
Standardize in-modal deletions to use transition navigation handlers.
BUG-041: Docker Desktop socket deletion and Telegram listener HTTP 409 collision. (Docker Desktop Socket Deletion and Telegram Listener Collision)
System Integrity
RESOLVED

1. A duplicate container stack was running under the legacy host `snap.docker.dockerd` service, running an older `telegram_listener.py` instance that collided with the new Docker Desktop stack.
2. The legacy snap container stack bound to Port 8000 on the host, preventing the new gateway from routing web traffic.

Four post-login architectural bottlenecks in /admin/operations: (1) Monolithic controller executing all 22 SQL queries for all 11 departments on every tab click; (2) Correlated subqueries per row on Customers, Leads, ConstructionBids, InstitutionalBids, GeneralContractors, and Employees plus missing composite indexes on GlobalActivities and CampaignRecipients; (3) Uncached 11-Rack self-healing telemetry + .env disk reads + DNS socket probes running synchronously on every page load; (4) Monolithic 16,900-line template rendering all 11 hidden views (2.6-3.3 MB HTML) and 391 KB inline JS on every click.

Implemented HWB-QMS-11.14 v1.1.0 (Release v5.4.4): (1) 300s TTL thread-safe cache with non-blocking background daemon refresh on all 10 self_healing_engine.py Racks and credential_sentinel.py; (2) Migration 043 creating 4 covering composite indexes (idx_global_activities_parent_lookup, idx_campaign_recipients_lead_lookup, idx_leads_assigned_rep_status, idx_employee_documents_employee_id) and replacing correlated subqueries with set-based LEFT JOIN LATERAL / CTE aggregations; (3) Active-View CQRS SQL isolation in blueprints/operations.py with 30s cached sidebar counts (_get_operations_sidebar_counts); (4) Server-side Jinja active_view DOM pruning in templates/backoffice_operations.html + static JS extraction to /static/js/backoffice_operations_core.js.
